hypotheses.name: Cloud Buffering
hypotheses.statement: Earth's globally-averaged albedo maintains its stability and symmetry through cloud buffering: clouds scattering compensates variations in surface albedo and aerosols that would otherwise impact albedo.
hypotheses.source: Stephens et al. (2015); Feldman et al. (2026) Nature paper

testable_predictions.prediction: Cloud area fraction inversely and causally responds to surface albedo perturbations

hypotheses.name: Invariant Earth System Properties
hypotheses.statement: Earth's TOA albedo stability and hemispheric symmetry result from properties of the Earth system at the surface and in the troposphere that are invariant on 21st Century timescales.

testable_predictions.prediction: Physical constants constrain albedo to the observed ~29% range

hypotheses.name: Teleconnections
hypotheses.statement: Hemispheric albedo symmetry is maintained by spatial teleconnections — cross-regional and cross-hemispheric correlations in cloud, aerosol, and surface albedo fields that actively couple distant regions.

testable_predictions.prediction: NH and SH albedo anomalies are significantly correlated

hypotheses.name: Coupled Low-Dimensional Hemispheric Oscillator
hypotheses.statement: Earth's global TOA albedo stability arises from a coupled low-dimensional dynamical system: the NH and SH albedo anomaly subsystems each occupy ~2-dimensional manifolds, but their cross-hemispheric coupling (SH driving NH at sub-annual lags) reduces the effective dimensionality of the global system below 2. This hemispheric coupling acts as a dimensionality-reducing constraint — correlated hemispheric responses to external forcing collapse the state space, explaining why global albedo is even more stable than either hemisphere alone.
hypotheses.source: Generated from prior run — combines H002 (low dimensionality) with H003 (hemispheric coupling)

testable_predictions.prediction: Joint NH+SH phase space has a dominant first PC capturing >80% of variance
SH->NH Granger causality is significant at 3-6 month lags, stronger than NH->SH
Mutual information between NH and SH exceeds what independent 2D attractors would produce
A 2-variable coupled model (NH+SH) reproduces the observed global correlation dimension of ~1.86
